provenance.author: Codex implementation agent; reviewable technical judgments, not external human annotation
provenance.license: Newly authored reviewable fixture; no third-party text or external license asserted.
provenance.label_method: Explicit technical-objective and failure-mechanism judgments authored by a Codex agent before any evaluated encoder run; no evaluated-encoder-derived relevance labels.
provenance.relevance_definition: Useful prior work on the same technical objective/mechanism, including independent regression tests; lexical overlap, project membership, and historical task continuity alone are insufficient.
provenance.negative_policy: Every candidate outside the query family is judged irrelevant; within each family all six candidates have an explicit rationale. Both query rewrites share the same objective and judgments.
provenance.split_policy: Development and locked test share no projects, families or rewrite groups. Each query deliberately retrieves same-family prior candidates in its own split. No supervised training or threshold tuning occurs.
provenance.freeze_policy: Freeze content SHA-256 in manifest before encoding. Never revise this version based on measured ranks; any later revision must have a new dataset identity.
provenance.continuation_policy: Related independent work is relevant but has no authoritative task/session link; relevance is never a continuation label.
limitations: Small purposive English coding examples authored by one agent.
No independent external human adjudication; labels and realism are reviewable assumptions.
Two queries per family are correlated rewrites, not independent samples.
Documentation/changed-scope negatives intentionally challenge objective discrimination.
No real executions, task outcomes, success labels, semantic classification or evolution labels.

queries.text: Make updated account settings visible immediately instead of returning the cached old values.
After a profile write, later reads still show yesterday's preferences; remove the stale entry.
A daily reminder jumps by an hour after daylight saving time; keep it at nine in the user's timezone.
Persist a recurring appointment as a local wall-clock time so the spring clock change does not move it.
Fix a race condition in session handling when two refresh requests update authentication state at once.
Simultaneous renewals overwrite a login record with stale credentials; prevent the lost update.
Speed up the invoice search by tenant and date; the database scans every row despite a small result set.
The billing lookup walks the whole relation to filter one customer organization and a time interval; inspect the access path.
Make the modal accessible to keyboard users: keep Tab inside it and return focus to the opener on close.
People navigating without a mouse can tab behind the overlay and lose their place after dismissing it.
Repair the Linux wheel so users can import the package without a compiler; include the native shared library.
Our binary distribution installs but fails to find its extension on a clean machine; fix the bundled artifacts.
Prevent duplicate charges when the queue delivers the same payment job twice after a retry.
Replayed checkout messages debit the buyer again; make processing safe under at-least-once delivery.
Stop uploaded ZIP archives from writing outside the extraction directory through ../ filenames.
An imported bundle can escape the staging folder using parent-relative member paths; enforce containment.
